sentences.text: BY THE PRL.
SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND ADDL. MACT HUBLI IN MVC  NO.947/2013
, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND ANY OTHER RELIEF
MAY KINDLY BE GRANTED.

THIS MFA COMING ON FOR DISMISSAL, THIS   ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 CORAM: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE K.MANMADHA RAO  -2-  NC: 2026:KHC-D:18  MFA No. 102732 of 2016 HC-KAR  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel Sri. L.M. Kurahatti, the proxy counsel appearing for the appellant, represented the matter and sought time.
However, on perusal of the order sheet, it appears that this Court has already granted ample opportunities to the appellant for hearing the matter.

Though the matter was posted for dismissal,
the appellant's counsel has not appeared and is represented only by a proxy counsel, which is not proper.
It appears that the appellant is not interested in prosecuting the appeal.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.

Sd/-
